label: Bounding the review reply: a guard that turns an error into a valid-looking result

origin.note: Absence-shaped: the defect is a report that is missing, not a line that is wrong. The anchor names the cap that creates the hazard; the range covers the code that should have reported it.

defects.description: Bounding analysis makes a guillotined review valid — complete JSON, finish_reason stop, usually an empty findings list — so it renders identically to a review that looked properly and found nothing. parseFindings reports atCap but has nothing for a cut analysis.
